title: State Of The Union 2026 Rapid Recap: Trump's Biggest Economic Remarks
summary: State of the Union economic claims: tariffs paid by foreigners could replace income tax, core inflation at a five-year low, gasoline and groceries cheaper, mortgage rates lowest in years.

assertions.quote: our nation is back bigger, better, richer, and stronger than ever before
Countries that were ripping us off for decades are now paying us hundreds of billions of dollars.
the tariffs paid for by foreign countries will, like in the past, substantially replace the modern day system of income tax
my administration has driven core inflation down to the lowest level in more than five years

verdicts.note: A three-month annualized core rate dipped in late 2025, helped by shutdown-distorted rent data, but year-over-year core inflation stayed near two and a half to three percent, not a five-year low.
Core CPI was 2.6% in November and December 2025, the lowest since March 2021 (1.6%), which is four years and eight months, not more than five years; April 2021 was already 3.0%.

assertions.quote: under my predecessor, it was, quite honestly, a disaster, is now below $2.30 a gallon in most states

verdicts.note: The national average near three dollars in early 2026 was below most of 2022-2024, though well above the sub-2.30 figure claimed for most states.

January and February 2026 regular gasoline were 2.809 and 2.908 (mean 2.859), 17.4% below the Biden-period mean of 3.461 and 42% below the 4.929 peak; it stopped being true in the second week of March 2026 (weekly 03/09 3.502) and March's monthly average of 3.638 was already above the Biden mean.

assertions.quote: The cost of chicken, butter, fruit, hotels, automobiles, rent is lower today than when I took office by a lot.

verdicts.note: Egg prices fell from their avian-flu spike, but CPI rent, lodging and food-at-home indexes all rose over 2025.

The food index rose 2.9% from January 2025 to January 2026 (335.517 to 345.165) and shelter rose 3.0% (409.153 to 421.526), so groceries and rent were higher, not lower; hotels and cars are not in these series.

assertions.quote: Mortgage rates are the lowest in four years and falling fast

verdicts.note: Thirty-year rates near six percent in early 2026 were the lowest since 2022 but above early-2022 levels, and they rose back above seven percent later in the year.
